# A canvas reads its pixel size off a literal prop, so a size written as
# arithmetic -- `W * 1px`, the only way to derive one from a const -- has to
# fold to one literal. The folder's value model has no unit: parseLiteral
# answers nil for `1px`, so the whole product stayed an expression and every
# platform fell back to the 300x150 default.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out app.sngl
grep 'width="400px"' out/index.html
grep 'height="60px"' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:app"
import . "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

const W = 200.0
const H = 120.0

component main {
    window #w {
        draw.canvas(width=W * 2 * 1px, height=H * 1px / 2) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=W, h=H, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=color{r=200, g=0, b=0, a=255}})
        }
    }
}
